notes: Reconciled from coders A and B. Single university-layer document (LSU Faculty Senate GAI guidelines, Dec 2025); no school or computing-unit policy found; course layer deferred. Exact repeats of the enforcement ('Any possible violation...'), responsibility and translation sentences inside the syllabus templates were coded once. UNCOVERED units: malicious-use bans, illicit-content/misinformation bans (student and faculty lists), instructor supervision of student GAI use, and personalized-learning benefit; no new types proposed.

documents.title: Guidelines on the Use of Generative AI in Curriculum
tiers: Option 1: Prohibited - No Use of GAI
Option 2: Permitted with Full Disclosure and Reflection
documents.summary: Faculty Senate guidelines endorsed Dec 2025 for generative AI in curriculum. They set student and faculty obligations, lists of acceptable and prohibited uses, and three sample syllabus statements (prohibit, permit with disclosure, permit with limits), leaving each course's rule to the instructor.
documents.stance_why: The document says it provides 'faculty the freedom to set course policies' and offers three syllabus options (prohibited, permitted with full disclosure, permitted with specific limitations); it sets no single stance, though use is 'only acceptable if clearly established by the course instructor', so it delegates with tiers.

units.why: Defines Generative AI as able to 'generate novel text, images, or other outputs', which sets what the guidelines cover; P61.
units.resolution_why: Only coder A coded this sentence. It defines GAI ('use those patterns to generate novel text, images, or other outputs'); definitions are in scope, so kept as informs.
units.anchor: use those patterns to generate novel text, images, or other outputs

units.why: The summary frames purpose and scope: guidance for faculty and students on responsible use including MikeGPT, so an institution-level framework (P56).
units.resolution_why: Only coder B coded this sentence. 'These draft guidelines provide initial guidance on GAI policies to help faculty and students' states the scope and purpose of the document; kept as general/informs.
